issues.title: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile
issues.impact: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile.
issues.current: We’re progressing with deploying the code fix to repair the remaining affected contacts on a user basis. The deployment is ongoing and expected to complete by Tuesday, November 24, 2026.
issues.scope: Some users attempting to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Admins' mail-enabled security groups created through the admin center UI may be provisioned incorrectly
issues.impact: Admins' mail-enabled security groups created through the admin center UI may have been provisioned incorrectly.
issues.current: We've completed deployment of our fix and confirmed through internal testing that the impact is remediated. All newly created mail-enabled security groups created through the Exchange admin center or Microsoft 365 admin center will be created as designed. Affected admins will need to recreate any groups provisioned incorrectly during the duration of the impact.
issues.scope: Some admins that attempted to create mail-enabled security groups in the Exchange admin center or Microsoft 365 admin center may have been affected.

issues.title: Users may be unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users may have experienced delays or failures receiving chat messages in Microsoft Teams desktop client
issues.impact: Users may have experienced delays or failures receiving chat messages in Microsoft Teams desktop client.
issues.current: We’ve completed the reversion of the service change responsible for the impact and confirmed that new instances of the issue are no longer occurring. Previously affected users who continue to experience residual impact can restart the Microsoft Teams desktop client to restore functionality, while remaining affected clients are expected to recover automatically. In addition, we’ve received confirmation from a number of affected users that impact has been remediated.
issues.scope: Impact was specific to some users receiving chat messages through the Microsoft Teams desktop client.

issues.title: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit
issues.impact: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit.
issues.current: The processing of the backlog of affected events is taking an extended period to complete and we're continuing to monitor it as it steadily progresses.
issues.scope: Any admin attempting to access audit log data from Microsoft Purview Audit may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Agents are unable to access Dynamics 365 Contact Center
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Power Apps mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune
issues.impact: Users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune.
issues.current: We’ve confirmed that a recent Windows security update, MSRC144654, can cause a single check in to fail during installation. We’re developing a fix to address this issue and anticipate its release for early December 2026. We’ll provide a better estimate for the delivery of our fix when available.
issues.scope: Some users with Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune may experience delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes while their devices install Windows security update MSRC144654. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Some users aren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
issues.impact: Users weren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
issues.current: We identified that a recent service-side update resulted in the inability to upload new skills. We've applied a targeted code change to correct this issue and have confirmed through service-side reproduction that the issue is resolved.
issues.scope: Your organization was impacted, and some users weren't able to upload new skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.

issues.title: Users may be unable to connect to, or experience degraded functionality with Exchange Online
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Users may experience issues when utilizing multiple Microsoft 365 services
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users may not see free/busy info shared between organizations using cross-tenant access policy in Exchange Online
issues.impact: Users may not have seen free/busy info shared between organizations using cross-tenant access policy in Exchange Online.
issues.current: We've validated that our fix has saturated across the affected environment and internal telemetry shows that users are able to view free/busy information shared between organizations using cross-tenant access policy as expected. We advise admins and users who have utilized the workaround provided in the "More info" section of this communication" to disable Organization Relationship to ensure cross-tenant admin policy is working as expected post-remediation.
issues.scope: This issue impacted some users whose organization utilized cross-tenant access policy, who may have been unable to view free/busy info shared between organizations in Exchange Online.

issues.title: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the Pro Management Portal (PMP) in Microsoft Teams
issues.impact: Admins may have seen Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the PMP in Microsoft Teams.
issues.current: We've completed deployment of our fixes to rebalance the service and redirect request traffic from the Teams client away from PMP. After monitoring our service health telemetry, we confirmed that the impact is remediated as a result of these actions.
issues.scope: This event may have impacted any admin that attempted to manage Windows and Android devices through the Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal.
